pilots_never_exam: Every hidden world of this study is a public function of public seeds (prior seeds 2026 and 2027, neighbour seeds 606000 + draw) and its weights are in origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/<job>/out/full/<arm>/worlds.json. They, their Lab data and their items must never be reused as an exam.

weight_error_equivalent.what: eps of a weight neighbour (W = sqrt(1 - eps^2) W_true + eps W_fresh) whose simulator, run from the hidden state, has the same pooled skill as the policy; log-linear interpolation between eps 0.03, 0.1, 0.3; written after the results

by_horizon.what: per query horizon: oracle-normalised skill of C and P0, the share of C's skill taken with no hypothesis and no experiment, and sigma against the Lab budget (1 - best null share); point values, written after the results

compute.what: member-ticks an agent needs for the no-experiment policy of arm P: finding screened worlds (round-5 screen with the weights-only pre-screen: member-ticks of job r5-foundry-002's enrichment arm per candidate found; without it: job r5-foundry-001's screen per candidate), the exam-time gate (8 members x 332 ticks per candidate), 64 training episodes per world; one episode with burn-in = 332 ticks. Written after the results; weight statistics of the pre-screen not counted.

between_jobs.what: arm P: the same hidden worlds and training worlds in both jobs; items, Labs, noise secret and every training seed differ, and C has more data and steps in the final job. Pooled skill.

tracker_centres.what: round-5 screen (job r5-foundry-001, ticks 50-290) of the three centres: mean number of tracked bodies, share of the mass in bodies, fusions + fissions per 100 ticks and member. The object view is not examined in this pilot.

wind_probe.what: CPU probe before the exam (round5/foundry/wind_probe.py, 8 states per world): aimed 200-nat command, displacement of the block view at 4 ticks over twice the noise floor, and in units of the variance
